title: The bpser branch differential: a research-model score, not a production pass rate
status_plain: A Python transcription of BRATIO was raced against correctly-rounded betainc on FDIST and TDIST rows. bpser evaluated in plain double beat the correctly-rounded reference, which is a literal code identity finding: Excel is running the less-accurate branch. F.DIST.RT's only own figure in the whole lane is the bpser 5/5 in this sentence, and it is a research-model score, not a production pass rate.
